Malorian Arms Sub-Flechettes.name: Sub-Flechettes de Malorian Arms
Malorian Arms Sub-Flechettes.description: Munición especial para usar solo con la pistola Sub-Flechette de Malorian Arms. Ablaciona la armadura 4 SP por golpe.

Nova Model 757 Rounds.name: Rondas del Modelo de Nova 757
Nova Model 757 Rounds.description:
For use only in the Nova Model 757 Cityhunter. Comes in packs of 18 instead of the normal 10.

 

Req Targeting Scope Cyberware, otherwise won't fire. If miss single attack by 4 or less, roll second attack at same DV 1d10+10 (not normal stat). Can add luck. Target can dodge the second roll as normal if able to do so.

Arasaka WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon.name: Arma de Asalto Bullpup Arasaka WAA
Arasaka WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon.description:
A bullpup rifle in operation for over two decades. Can fire non-basic ammunition and comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Constitutional Arms Multiple Ammunition.name: Pistola de munición múltiple de Armas Constitucionales
Constitutional Arms Multiple Ammunition.description:
A very heavy pistol capable of loading up to five different ammo types at once*, with the user able to pick between them before firing.

*Currently not supported, so users have to manually change ammo types

IMI Chainknife.name: Cuchillo encadenado IMI
IMI Chainknife.description:
Takes an action to rev up, but once revved is a powerful melee weapon. When not revved deals 2d6 damage*.

*Not revved mode not currently supported, so will need to manually reduce damage

Kendachi Dragon Flamethrower.name: Lanzallamas de Dragón de Kendachi
Kendachi Dragon Flamethrower.description: Fuego en la punta de tus dedos. Solo puedes disparar proyectiles de escopeta incendiaria, pero objetivos encendidos por esta arma queman por 4 PV por turno.

Magnum Opus Hellbringer.name: Magnum Opus Hellbringer
Magnum Opus Hellbringer.description: Cuando esto dispara, lo sabrás. Si alguien con menos de TCO 10 dispara esta pistola, se atasca. Se requiere una acción para desatascarla.

Malorian Arms Sub-Flechette Gun.name: Pistola Sub-Flechette de Malorian Arms
Malorian Arms Sub-Flechette Gun.description:
This SMG can only fire it's own custom Armor-Piercing Ammunition, however that ammo ablates by 4 when dealing damage. Comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Militech Crusher.name: Triturador Militech
Militech Crusher.description: A pistol that fires shotgun shells. What's not to love.

Mustang Arms ARS-5 Submachine Gun.name: Subfusil ARS-5 de Mustang Arms
Mustang Arms ARS-5 Submachine Gun.description:
This heavy SMG is the complete package; it comes with a Smartgun Link, Infrared Nightvision Scope, and a Sniping Scope*.

*All three must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun.name: Cañón de perno pneumático Nomade
Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun.description: Capaz de disparar todas las municiones no básicas, esta arma sigue siendo tan versátil como cuando fue inventada hace más de dos décadas.

Nova Model 757 Cityhunter.name: Nova Modelo 757 Cityhunter
Nova Model 757 Cityhunter.description:
This pistol fires it's own custom rounds bought in packs of 18, though they cost the same as a pack of 10. Comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Stolbovoy ST-5 Assault Rifle.name: Rifle de Asalto ST-5 de Stolbovoy
Stolbovoy ST-5 Assault Rifle.description: A - arma relativamente fiable. Si tira 1 en Ataque (fallo crítico), entonces debe tirar una moneda; si usted gana el tiro sale como de costumbre, mientras que si pierde el arma se atasca y requiere utilizar una acción para desatascar.

Teen Dreem.name: Teen Dreem
Teen Dreem.description: Este SMG puede usar fuego automático y fuego supresivo hasta las últimas 2 balas. Sin embargo, es necesario tener cuidado, ya que usar cualquiera de los modos de disparo fundir la pistola más allá de la reparación.
